north_star_definition: MetaCore is a Persistent AI Operating Platform connecting identity, context, persistent state, AI, orchestration, tools, execution, evidence and platform economics into continuing human-governed work.
short_definition: Models provide intelligence. MetaCore provides the platform where intelligence can remember, coordinate and act.
model_neutral_lines: Bring your intelligence. Keep your context.
Models can change. Your operational context should not.

PLATFORM_SERVICES.label: Platform Services
PLATFORM_SERVICES.role: Shared platform services used across products and workspaces.

OPERATING_CORE.label: MetaCore OS · Operating, Context & Control Core
OPERATING_CORE.role: Operational coordination, context, policy and control core; not the whole MetaCore platform.

AI_CAPABILITY.label: AI Capability
AI_CAPABILITY.role: Composable intelligence, persistent AI roles and specialist capability modules.

PERSISTENT_RESOURCES.label: Persistent Resources
PERSISTENT_RESOURCES.role: Persistent state and working resources; capacity is a class/metric rather than the product essence.

ORCHESTRATION.label: Hierarchical AI Orchestration
ORCHESTRATION.role: Persona -> Agents -> Workflows; supports orchestration of orchestrators within scoped authority.

INTEGRATION_FABRIC.label: Integration Fabric
INTEGRATION_FABRIC.role: Connects models, workspaces, services and external systems; integration is distinct from execution.

EXECUTION.label: Execution
EXECUTION.role: Action plane controlled by native safety, authority, evidence and external-action gates.

SECURITY_PLANE.rule: Cross-cuts every platform plane; capability never implies permission.

EVIDENCE_PLANE.rule: Cross-cuts every plane; evidence class, source ownership and verification remain explicit.

ECONOMY_PLANE.rule: Cross-cuts platform services and products; KR are service credits, not money/crypto/cash-out/automatic FX.

products.rule: Products are composed on top of MetaCore infrastructure; they are not themselves the platform planes.

canonical_brand_map.B1 / Orchestration: Hierarchical AI Orchestration / AI Persona Orchestration Layer
canonical_brand_map.Personal / Business / Field / MarsNet: Products or deployment profiles built on MetaCore

persona_agent_model.persona: Persistent AI work role with context, policy, scoped authority, domain cores, continuity, agents and tools.
persona_agent_model.agent: Task executor operating inside assigned scope and tool boundaries.
persona_agent_model.principle: Persona is not merely another agent; MetaCore may orchestrate orchestrators.

resource_semantics.capacity_rule: GB capacity is a class/limit; the product essence is work scale and continuity.

marsnet_position: Industrial MetaCore deployment/product profile; robotics, mission operations and physical systems remain under native deterministic safety and scoped authority.

model_neutrality.rule: Intelligence provider may change while MetaCore preserves authorized context, state, tools, evidence and continuity.

authority_rule: Dignity is universal; authority is scoped by canonical policy, authenticated role, delegated mandate and resource/action scope. Human-governed work preserves legitimate human purpose, agency and consent without granting blanket identity-based system authority.

epistemic_orientation.rule: The unknown is not empty. The hypothetical is not proven. The metaphysical is not a verdict. Any of these may generate direction, questions or hypotheses, but factual promotion requires re-grounding to claim-appropriate evidence and source authority.
epistemic_orientation.metaphysical_role: Orientation / meaning / pattern exploration / alternative perspective; never automatic factual, medical, legal, technical or action authority.

compatibility.v1: METACORE_PLATFORM_IDENTITY_V1.json is retained as lineage and compatibility reference.
compatibility.os_layer_alias: Operating, Context & Control Layer remains accepted public shorthand for MetaCore OS.
compatibility.older_context_os_language: Supporting historical/narrow narrative only; not the top-level category.
